social-emotional-development-ecological.alt: Nested ovals around a child. Microsystem, closest: family, classroom, friends. Mesosystem: the links between them, such as parents talking with teachers. Exosystem: settings the child is not in that still matter, such as a parent’s workplace, the school board and media. Macrosystem, outermost: culture, values, laws and the economy. An arrow along the bottom shows the chronosystem: every layer changes over time, through life changes and historical events.
